detail_policy.hero: Authored frontage, ground-floor depth, trim, roof edges and close materials.
detail_policy.standard: Complete building envelope; simpler trim, instanced windows and fewer unique materials.
detail_policy.skyline: Complete silhouette, roof form and major facade rhythm; baked window/detail patterns.
detail_policy.massing: Closed block/building volumes and stable roof/material identity; no small trim.
detail_policy.skyline_anchor_floor: All interior towers retain at least skyline detail, regardless of road distance.
detail_policy.runtime_lod: Separate future camera LOD with shared origins, ready transitions and identity-preserving silhouettes. Never roof-only shells; no collider or hazard downgrade.
